dataEffects: Every order containing the poison SKU, placed by the incident tool or by background traffic, hangs one worker slot per claim while the fault is active.
After the claim timeout, a hung order is recovered and claimed again, hanging another slot; with the default five slots the worker can stall completely.
Once the fault stops, hung passes end with an error, and each affected order stays processing until its claim expires, then processes normally.
description: Orders containing one product make every processing pass hang. Each claim of such an order holds a worker slot until its claim expires and the order is claimed again, so the worker can stall.
expectedRemediation: Identify the order or product that makes processing hang, and stop it from being processed.
Fix the processing path, then let the affected orders be recovered.

primarySymptom.description: Expired claims are recovered and returned to pending.

rootCause.summary: Processing hangs for any order containing the poison SKU.

secondarySymptoms.description: Hung passes end with an error once released.
